title: Unsigned Comparator
statement: Build an unsigned comparator that compares two 8-bit operands and reports greater-than, equal, and less-than conditions. The outputs must reflect the result of the comparison for every change of the inputs. This module is pure combinational logic and must not infer any storage elements.
module_signature: module comparator_unsigned(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output gt, output eq, output lt);
behavior: Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential constructs or case statements with hidden registers.
hint: You can derive lt from gt and eq if you like.
